data.title: 夏夜泳池池畔的碧蓝水光
data.location: 只亮水下池灯的度假别墅露天夜泳池
data.lighting: 泳池水下青蓝反射光与露台暖壁灯
data.camera: 贴池沿略俯视斜角中景
data.prompt: adult, 1girl, solo, shiki_natsume, natsume_r18, matte black criss-cross wrap bikini, side-tie bottoms, sheer white linen cover-up shirt draped off wet shoulders, wet black hair slicked back from collarbone, water droplets glistening on cleavage and flat midriff, arms resting on tiled pool edge leaning toward viewer, teasing half-lidded golden gaze, slight blush, glowing turquoise underwater pool lights casting caustics upward onto skin, dark night resort terrace, warm distant deck lantern, from above, dutch angle, medium shot
data.animaCaption: Resting her forearms along the wet pool tiles with a sheer white linen cover-up slipping off her glistening shoulders over her black wrap bikini, she gazes up through half-lidded golden eyes. Glowing turquoise underwater lights send shimmering ripples across her wet skin and collarbone.
data.promptProse: Captured from a slightly elevated angle at the rim of an illuminated villa swimming pool at night, Shiki Natsume leans her damp arms onto the cool porcelain edge wearing a sleek matte-black criss-cross bikini with a sheer white linen beach shirt slipped lazily off her shoulders. Droplets sparkle along her wet collarbone, midriff, and slicked-back black hair as glowing turquoise pool lights project dancing water caustics upward onto her face and chin, balanced by a warm golden lantern flickering across the shadowed resort deck.
data.story: 夜风吹过寂静的别墅露台，只有水下池灯把池面照成一片流动的碧蓝。夏目双臂交叠撑在微凉瓷砖边，水珠沿着湿润锁骨滑进黑色绑带间，她微抬眼眸带着几分促狭看你——「站在岸上光看多没意思，不敢下来吗？」
